author: GameTrailers
description:
Here's your look at the release date trailer for the upcoming time-traveling, turn-based JRPG, Another Eden Begins. Cross the boundaries of the cosmos as Aldo, on a quest to save his sister Feinne from the clutches of evil. Cross timeless paths, forging deep connections with over 18 memorable companions. Complete ally quests to deepen your relationships and unlock special kinship quests. 
Another Eden Begins is launching on September 17, 2026, for Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam).
title: Another Eden Begins - Official Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest trailer for Reverse: 1999. Reverse: 1999's Version 3.4 update introduces Paper Heron, a new limited 6-star character and wandering Daoist swordswoman who follows her own path to restore balance in the world. Version 3.4 significantly expands gameplay with new and returning systems. Version 3.4 update, “Spring Unending,” launches April 16, 2026 on PC (Steam) and mobile platforms.
Reverse: 1999 is a 20th-century time-travel strategic RPG. On the final day of 1999, The Storm descended, reversing time itself. Players take on the role of the Timekeeper, travelling across eras from the Roaring ‘20s to the turn of the millennium to uncover the truth behind the phenomenon.
title: Reverse: 1999 - Official Version 3.4 Spring Unending Trailer
